That's not a fair representation of the majority of the userbase in EVE.

Here's the thing, you will find this and a lot worse in eve. You'll also find a lot better. What's displayed here reflects only one (arguably large) facet of the game and while intensity is normal this is cherry picked to be over the top. Most fleets are going to be nowhere this level.

However if this is such a big turn off to you I'd say eve isn't going to be your game. The thing is while this level is certainly not the norm, there is a reason for it. Assets in game are at much higher risk so dying carries a significant penalty, which makes you care much more about every loss and kill. That's is the big draw for a lot of us, that rush of adrenaline when you almost lose your pretend internet spaceship but manage to get scrams and webs on that fucking cepter and pop him before his buddys arive. If the high stakes thing isn't your cup of tea that's cool but you might not enjoy eve.

Edit: For context here's the other side of the coin. https://youtu.be/AdfFnTt2UT0 That's the original video, also with real player recordings. The visuals match up to what was happening while the audio was recorded too (it was just rerendered by CCP to be all clean and pretty).

If you can deal with peoples shit and want to play a game packed full of liars, trolls, and spies who will earn your trust just for the joy of stabbing you in the back after setting you up for IRL months, you'll like Eve.
